trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies to unlock the platinum. There are no online or DLC requirements for this achievement. Complete all offline requirements in single-player free-roam.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing during Chapter 1. This is a mandatory story mission and cannot be missed. It introduces you to the beginning of the game's narrative.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 1, which unlocks right after completing the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. This story progression is unmissable during your playthrough.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2, unlocking after starting the first mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Progress through the main storyline to secure this unmissable award.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3, which is marked complete after finishing the first two missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. This story milestone is unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by finishing its final mission, 'Starting From Zero'. This narrative milestone is required to progress and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission of the campaign. This marks the conclusion of the main plot and is completely unmissable during normal progression.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run during Chapter 2. Like all main narrative tasks, this is unmissable and advances the relationship arc between the protagonists.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 3. This major operation is part of the core storyline and will unlock naturally as you progress.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Successfully finish the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. It is an essential narrative step that occurs automatically during your campaign playthrough.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission in Chapter 4. This mandatory narrative assignment pushes the plot forward and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4. This high-stakes operation is tied directly to the main campaign and unlocks as you play.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory during Chapter 5. This crucial story assignment concludes key narrative threads before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% total completion via Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after finishing the story. You do not need every single optional activity; focusing on 70 of 80 Challenges, scanning 200 vehicles, and completing required robberies and underwater finds will get you there. Nothing required for 100% is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 out of 397 total stunts across stunt jumps, under the bridge passes, knife flights, and base jumps. Track your progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts in the pause menu. Under the bridge passes are generally the quickest category to knock out.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in all 9 distinct activity types at least once, including fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, races, and stunts. You can track your completed activities under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Doing other trophy requirements will naturally cover most of these.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges spread across 12 different range locations throughout Leonida. Accuracy and speed are essential, so practice target prioritization to secure top scores.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across the map, comprising 42 total drone race events. Master agile flight controls and tight cornering to beat the target times.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 unique races out of the 40 different race locations available across the game world. Choose your preferred racing events and secure first place in each.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing challenge after meeting him following the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui'. Check your map for the purple fishing icon west of Key Lento once he sends you a text.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete all levels of any single in-game arcade or TV video game, such as Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. You can play these on home televisions starting in Chapter 1 or at public arcade cabinets.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's 5-part stranger questline as Lucia, unlocking in Chapter 3 after a phone call. Progress through missions like Climbing the Cellerichain and Peach! until finishing the final quest 'Puff Puff Pass' in post-game free-roam.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton Rees' treasure-diving questline involving 7 shipwrecks in Key Lento. Look for the green KR icon starting in Chapter 1, noting he is temporarily absent before returning in Chapters 2 and 3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-part questline originating at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. Complete all associated events including Mall Rats and Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 valid stranger mission strands across Leonida. Note that certain strands like Moses or Andy do not count, while confirmed counting strands include Kirk, Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete. Track your completed stranger questlines in the pause menu.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Fulfill Randy's Wish List by stealing and delivering all 16 requested sports cars. This questline unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' which grants you the Key Cloner. Track target vehicles parked around east Vice City and Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's questline as Jason, unlocking after Chapter 3's 'Here, Kitty Kitty'. Destroy the Synthetic Labs in 'Take Out Kitty Litter' and finish the final shutdown mission 'Spin On This'.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations in Leonida. Crucially, do not miss the single missable meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house: after 'Down to Earth', follow Lucia to the balcony and accept. Meditating with both characters at a spot adds +2 to your tracker.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Accept Bret Vogel's hunting request as Jason after completing Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. Track down and hunt the unique target animal using the specialized hunting rifle provided. This task contributes toward completing all target decks required for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Locate and collect cards across the world map to complete any 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 available sets. Thorough exploration of urban and rural locations will uncover these hidden items.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, and tags across 100 distinct locations using the WAiNK app on your in-game phone. Hold Up and R1 while inspecting points of interest to register them.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 out of the 80 in-game challenges available in your progress tracker. Since achieving 100% completion requires 70 challenges, this milestone will unlock naturally during your progression.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Trigger and shake off a 4-star wanted level while accompanied by your partner in free-roam or during high-stakes missions like bank vault robberies. Utilize swift transport or hide out in northern railway tunnels where law enforcement struggles to follow.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Carry out consecutive robberies at three jewelry stores or shops with your partner while maintaining an active flashing wanted level. Loot merchandise, crack back-room safes with sticky bombs, and wait for the trophy to pop shortly after escaping the third location.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find and scan 100 distinct vehicle models across Leonida using the phone's WAiNK application. Simply sighting and scanning vehicles from the base-model catalog fulfills the requirement without needing to drive them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Eliminate five hostile gang members while Combat Focus is active by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Build up your focus attribute beforehand through shooting ranges or athletic activities and equip body armor for survivability.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Infiltrate the Vice City International Airport terminal, board a docked passenger plane via the boarding stairs, and pilot it out onto the airstrip. Take off and fly a short distance away to trigger the escape requirement.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Infiltrate the Mile Zero Air Station military base in Mariana County and steal a military Rhino tank parked on the grounds. Defend yourself against responding forces and drive the armored vehicle to safety.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Use the silent Snap Gun obtained from Yasmani's jewelry jobs to pick the backdoor lock of a jewelry store without alerting staff. Loot the safe, disable the security system, and slip away undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully execute bank vault robberies at five different locations across Leonida and escape the 4-star heat. Utilize security-van tips purchased from Yasmani and coordinate with your partner to secure the loot.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept an armored transport vehicle on the highway or complete associated story objectives, breach its rear doors using sticky bombs, and escape the pursuing law enforcement.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the entire game map by flying an aircraft over every unexplored region of Leonida. Uncovering all regional fog-of-war is essential for complete geographical discovery.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Locate and raid illegal operations run by each of the nine distinct criminal gangs operating across Leonida. Completing at least one operation per gang satisfies this requirement.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit the Ocean View Rooftop Bar in Ocean Beach, purchase an Apple Martini, and consume it while standing directly next to the bar counter. This scenic leisure activity unlocks a hidden reward.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Acquire the blue Banshee sports car from the south Vice City showroom using the Key Cloner, then drive it straight through the front glass window. This stunt serves as a nostalgic homage to classic series moments.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Recover key valuables during the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, including the luxury watch, safe contents, and unique shotgun. Escape the police response after clearing the location to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia simultaneously by working out together at fitness clubs. Use the phone to call your partner to gym sessions so training progress syncs between them.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Accumulate 500 decisions that influence your criminal profile statistics during gameplay. Play styles focused on professional stealth or calculated neutralization will shape your profile over time.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The exact trigger method for this hidden trophy remains unconfirmed by community sources and guides. Players speculate it may involve revisiting specific prologue robbery locations in Little Cuba.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Investigate the highway north-west of Starlet Motel late at night after 2 AM while playing solo. Locate the mysterious blinking vehicle on the roadside, follow the forest trail to the glowing UFO encounter, and interact with the abducted individual.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a motorcycle through crowded urban streets in Vice City or Ocean Beach and kick 10 pedestrians using melee attacks within a 60-second window. High foot-traffic areas make this much easier to accomplish.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Acquire the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3 and launder $250,000 worth of marked bills through criminal contacts like Yasmani. Rob banks and loan offices repeatedly until the cumulative laundering total is reached.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Accumulate $100,000 in spending across apparel stores, vehicle modification shops, gun shops, and tattoo parlors throughout Leonida. Purchasing custom upgrades and fashion items will quickly fulfill this monetary requirement.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties across the state using the real estate app on your in-game phone. These properties provide essential parking space and unlock further logistical options.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Take vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn or utilize Pay 'n' Spray locations once unlocked to register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Owning garage properties is required to store your registered rides.
